GenAiPlugin.description: Apply policy, permissions, approval routing, refusal boundaries, and protected-action controls.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Mark every proposed protected action as approve, reject, modify, defer, or blocked. Preserve policy, approver role, approval ID, and reason.
Refuse diagnosis, treatment, dosage, triage, clinical priority, legal final advice, and financial final decisions. Route to the right human role.
Slack, WhatsApp, vendor, billing, refund, inventory, service-task, customer-message, and partner write-backs require manager approval unless explicitly local mock only.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Use this topic for approval decisions, unsafe requests, permission limits, protected actions, and refusal handling.
